betterquesting:10.desc:8:
You've built the satellite, now get it off the ground. A §6Satellite§f is a compact craftable item that performs a specific function once in orbit: ore scanning, biome mapping, mass detection, whatever you configured at the Satellite Builder.

To launch, you need a rocket with a §6Satellite Bay§f block installed. The bay loads the satellite into the payload slot, and once in orbit the satellite needs power (usually a Solar Panel) to stay operational. Data gets beamed down to your §6Satellite Control Center§f for processing.

The recipe in this pack uses an HBM Satellite Base and ID-Chip instead of the default AR materials, so check JEI for the actual components you need.

§cWARNING:§f A satellite without a power source shuts down within one in-game day. Make sure you have a Solar Panel ready before launch.
